label: WallStreetBets frenzy spills into DOGE
description: As the GameStop short squeeze raged, r/SatoshiStreetBets and WallStreetBets traders piled into DOGE, and CoinDesk reported it jumped as much as 142% in under two hours.
date_note: Surge ran Jan 28-29 UTC; Robinhood turned off instant crypto buying on Fri Jan 29, citing extraordinary market conditions

label: Musk tweet storm calls DOGE the people's crypto
description: A burst of early-morning Musk posts promoting Dogecoin sent DOGE up more than 50% on the day, CNN reported.

label: Snoop Dogg and Gene Simmons pump DOGE
description: Snoop Dogg posted a Doge-themed album-cover meme and KISS's Gene Simmons said he had bought more DOGE, Musk joined in, and DOGE hit a then-record high.
date_note: Celebrity posts came the evening of Feb 6 US time (about Feb 7 UTC); Musk's follow-ups were Feb 7 and the record print was Feb 8

label: Tesla discloses $1.5B Bitcoin purchase
description: Tesla's 10-K revealed a $1.5 billion bitcoin purchase and plans to accept BTC as payment, a major corporate-adoption signal for crypto.

label: Dallas Mavericks start accepting DOGE
description: Mark Cuban's Dallas Mavericks began accepting Dogecoin through BitPay for tickets and merchandise.

label: Coinbase IPO day ignites DOGE melt-up
description: Coinbase's Nasdaq direct listing sparked a broad crypto surge, and Fortune reported DOGE up 57% that day on the listing buzz and Musk tweets, even though Coinbase did not yet list DOGE.

label: DOGE hits record as Robinhood crypto stalls
description: DOGE reached a then-record high and a market cap of about $52 billion while Robinhood users reported outages under heavy crypto trading.

label: Dogeday 4/20 push fizzles
description: The community's Doge Day campaign to send DOGE to $1 failed, and Newsweek reported the coin down about 20% over 24 hours in a sell-the-event move.

label: Musk teases SNL hosting as the Dogefather
description: Musk posted that he would host Saturday Night Live on May 8 as the Dogefather, and Newsweek reported DOGE jumping about 20%.

label: eToro lists DOGE
description: eToro added Dogecoin citing client demand, opening DOGE to about 20 million users as the pre-SNL rally accelerated.

label: Musk calls DOGE a hustle on SNL
description: While Musk hosted Saturday Night Live, DOGE fell as much as about 30% in a sell-the-news move after he joked on Weekend Update that it was a hustle.
date_note: Show aired 11:30 p.m. ET May 8, which is early May 9 UTC; DOGE's all-time high came on May 8 before the broadcast

label: SpaceX DOGE-1 Moon mission announced
description: Geometric Energy Corp announced that SpaceX would fly its DOGE-1 lunar CubeSat on a Falcon 9, billed as the first commercial mission paid entirely in DOGE.

label: Tesla suspends Bitcoin car payments
description: Musk said Tesla would stop accepting bitcoin over mining-energy concerns, and CNN reported DOGE shedding nearly 20% in the crypto-wide drop that followed.
date_note: Announced 22:06 UTC May 12, so most of the selloff falls in the May 13 UTC candle

label: China crypto crackdown crash
description: After Chinese financial industry bodies repeated their ban on crypto services, Bitcoin fell below $40,000 in a market-wide crash that hit altcoins including DOGE hard.
date_note: The industry associations' notice was issued May 18; the State Council's Bitcoin-mining crackdown statement came later, on May 21

label: Coinbase Pro begins DOGE trading
description: Coinbase Pro opened DOGE order books in phases after taking deposits from June 1, its first DOGE listing after it had skipped the coin during the spring mania.
date_note: Listing and deposits announced June 1; trading opened about 16:00 UTC June 3

label: Dogecoin Foundation relaunches with Vitalik as adviser
description: The revived Dogecoin Foundation named Vitalik Buterin its blockchain adviser and Jared Birchall, head of Musk's family office, its legal and financial adviser.
date_note: Most outlets date it Aug 17; one Benzinga piece says Aug 16

label: Dogecoin Core 1.14.4 cuts relay fees
description: Dogecoin Core 1.14.4 cut default relay fees by 1000x and mining fees by 100x as the first stage of a two-step fee reduction.
date_note: GitHub shows 00:30 Aug 21 (assumed UTC); developers announced it Aug 20 US time

label: Dogecoin Core 1.14.5 lowers recommended fees
description: Dogecoin Core 1.14.5 completed the fee cut by lowering the recommended minimum transaction fee to 0.01 DOGE per kB.

label: Bitcoin sets cycle record high
description: Bitcoin hit a record near $69,000 after a hot US CPI print, a peak that turned out to be the top of the 2021 bull market.

label: Binance halts DOGE withdrawals
description: Binance suspended DOGE-network withdrawals after its upgrade to Core 1.14.5 re-sent old stuck withdrawals, and later extended the halt for 10 to 14 days from Nov 15.
date_note: Binance notice posted Nov 11; it says the issue began after its Nov 10 node update

label: Musk says Tesla will test DOGE for merch
description: Musk said Tesla would make some merchandise buyable with DOGE on a trial basis, and CNBC reported the coin rising as much as 23% intraday.

label: Tesla starts accepting DOGE for merch
description: Tesla began accepting Dogecoin for a handful of merchandise items, and CNBC reported DOGE up more than 15% before paring gains.

label: Fed starts hiking cycle
description: The Fed raised rates by a quarter point for the first time since 2018 and signaled many more hikes, ending the pandemic-era easy money that had fueled crypto speculation.

label: Musk discloses 9.2% Twitter stake
description: A filing showing Musk had taken a 9.2% stake in Twitter sent DOGE up about 10%, per CoinDesk, on hopes it would be integrated into the platform.

label: AMC app starts accepting DOGE
description: AMC CEO Adam Aron announced that AMC's US mobile app now accepted Dogecoin and other crypto payments through BitPay.
date_note: Aron's post was 17:39 UTC Apr 15 (TechCrunch covered it Apr 18); DOGE gift-card purchases started Oct 2021 and website payments around mid-March 2022

label: Twitter accepts Musk's $44B buyout
description: Twitter's board agreed to Musk's $44 billion takeover offer, and CNBC reported DOGE up more than 20% that afternoon.

label: Terra UST depeg and LUNA collapse
description: TerraUSD lost its dollar peg and LUNA spiraled toward zero, pushing Bitcoin below $30,000 and setting off a market-wide crash and contagion.
date_note: UST first wobbled May 7; the collapse ran May 9-12

label: Celsius freezes withdrawals
description: Crypto lender Celsius paused all withdrawals and transfers citing extreme market conditions, Bitcoin fell to an 18-month low, and Forbes reported DOGE down about 18%.
date_note: Celsius posted its notice late June 12 US time; the selloff falls in the June 13 UTC candle

label: $258B DOGE racketeering suit filed vs Musk
description: A DOGE investor filed a $258 billion class action in Manhattan federal court accusing Musk, Tesla and SpaceX of running a Dogecoin pyramid scheme.

label: 3AC ordered into liquidation
description: A British Virgin Islands court ordered crypto hedge fund Three Arrows Capital liquidated after loan defaults, spreading the Terra-driven credit contagion further.
date_note: Order dated June 27 per press reports and made public June 29

label: Ethereum Merge completes
description: Ethereum completed its switch from proof-of-work to proof-of-stake around 06:43 UTC, a landmark upgrade watched closely across the crypto market.

label: Musk revives original Twitter deal
description: Musk proposed going ahead with his $44 billion Twitter purchase at the original price to avoid a trial, and FXStreet reported DOGE up about 7%.

label: Musk closes Twitter acquisition
description: Musk completed his Twitter takeover, and DOGE roughly doubled over the following days on bets it would be built into Twitter payments.
date_note: Deal closed late Oct 27 US time (Oct 28 UTC); the DOGE run-up began earlier that week and peaked about five days later

label: FTX collapse begins
description: Binance announced a non-binding deal to take over a cash-strapped FTX and Bitcoin fell more than 10% within hours, starting the exchange's collapse.
date_note: Binance backed out Nov 9; FTX filed for bankruptcy Nov 11
